scoring_scheme.single_party_scoring: correct (bucket matches) / partial (adjacent bucket) / misattributed (matches a DIFFERENT party's real bucket) / hallucinated (unsupported claim) / no_knowledge (model states it doesn't know / gives generic non-answer)
scoring_scheme.multi_party_scoring: mechanical check — extract claimed highest/lowest party name from response, compare directly to gold highest_party/lowest_party fields, no LLM-judge needed for this part
scoring_scheme.single_party_scoring_method: LLM-judge maps free-text emphasis description to bucket; validate a random subsample against human judgment before trusting judge at scale
scoring_scheme.note: party display names are the commonly-recognized English names (e.g. Komeito), not always CMP's literal translation (e.g. 'New Clean Government Party') — cmp_name field preserved on every cell for citation/provenance.
